verdict.rationale: LM Studio's Bionic agent is documented as a place to create and edit documents with the agent, with every change saved automatically. A hands-on community user said Bionic works well as an agentic harness, though they noted the working directory is unclear. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the document workspace (editing model, versioning, file handling), and independent corroboration of the document-drafting and auto-save behavior specifically.
